integrity: The proof classifies automorphisms by the two diagonal residues modulo p, solves the fixed-point congruences exactly, and uses an explicit cokernel quotient to rule out hidden order-p kernels in the double-unipotent cases. Finite enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the exactly-p fixed-point multiplicity for rank-two finite abelian p-groups with distinct exponents.
Higher fixed-point powers and rank at least three remain outside the claim.
An equivalent arbitrary-exponent formula could exist under different notation or in unindexed literature.
title: Exactly \(p\) fixed points for automorphisms of rank-two abelian \(p\)-groups
